sloka: गुरुश्च राजा च पिता च वृद्धः ।क्रोधात्प्रहर्ष द्यदि वापि कामात् ।यद्व्यादिशेत् कार्यमवेक्ष्य धर्मम् ।कस्तन्न कुर्यादनृदनृशम्सवृत्तिः ॥२-२१-५८॥
transliteration: guruśca rājā ca pitā ca vṛddhaḥ ।krodhātpraharṣa dyadi vāpi kāmāt ।yadvyādiśet kāryamavekṣya dharmam ।kastanna kuryādanṛdanṛśamsavṛttiḥ ॥2-21-58॥

translations.english: Whatever a preceptor, an old man, a king and a father commands whether it is out of anger or pleasure or passion must be carried out as dharma. Who will not do it unless he is heartless?
